diwali.title: Shubh Deepavali
diwali.style: Original artwork, reverent and dignified, in the style of a richly detailed traditional Indian devotional painting with soft gold leaf highlights and warm diya light. Portrait 4:5 composition, subject centred with breathing room at the top. No text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no borders. Do not copy any existing poster, calendar art, film or TV depiction.

scenes.name: Lakshmi Ganesh
scenes.prompt: Goddess Lakshmi seated on a pink lotus beside Lord Ganesha, both serene and blessing with raised hands, Lakshmi in a red and gold saree with gold coins gently flowing from her palm, Ganesha with modak and a small mouse at his feet, rows of glowing clay diyas, marigold garlands and a rangoli in front, deep maroon and gold palette.

scenes.name: Ram Darbar
scenes.prompt: Ram Darbar: Lord Rama and Goddess Sita seated together on an ornate golden throne, Lakshmana and Bharata and Shatrughna standing beside them, Hanuman kneeling in devotion at their feet, a palace hall of Ayodhya lit by hundreds of oil lamps on Deepavali night, saffron, gold and deep blue palette.

scenes.name: Deepotsav
scenes.prompt: The city of Ayodhya on Deepavali night: steps of a river ghat lined with thousands of glowing clay diyas reflecting on the water, a temple silhouette, soft fireworks of gold in a deep indigo sky, lotus flowers floating with small lamps, peaceful and festive.
